text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad I went in person for both the
Arima Kinen and the Nikkei Shinshun Hai~! Rose,
Ruler,
that whole generation is seriously
amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As year's end turned into the New Year,
and the public's anticipation for even
fiercer battles grew—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overseas expeditions were confirmed
for both Victoire Pisa and Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I have received an invitation to the grand
stage in Dubai.
This will be my second challenge to the world—
so with no regrets and every ounce of my
strength,
I intend to weave our circle of hope.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Though it is a different race than Pisa and
the others,
I too have secured my ticket to Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This will be playing on thoroughly hostile
ground.
Since we are going that far,
I would want nothing less than a massive
return.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Setting out for Dubai,
are you? That is wonderful news.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Securing victory before the eyes of the
people holds tremendous significance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Public interest in the Rose Clan has grown
immensely as of late.
This will undoubtedly pave the way for the
future of our Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As planned, I intend to seize victory
in the domestic Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
—Speaking of invitations, that reminds me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: From me to you, please accept this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting it and opening it up—
only the date, time,
and location were written.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day, as they call it,
must be drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to share a meal with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the directions to the restaurant,
its grand exterior
instinctively made me straighten my
collar. Taking a steadying breath,
I opened the door.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Chime, chime...*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You're here. That was quick.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Please, take that table over there.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Relax your shoulders.
Today,
I truly hope you will unwind to your heart's
content.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Now then.
Before our meal,
let us converse for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
First, allow me to thank you once more
for walking this path alongside me.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
choice_data_list: Thank you very much as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the sort of 'king' I ought to
become...
I spoke to you of that once before,
did I not?
choice_data_list: This is the King of Dogs, the Wise...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back when her debut race had just ended,
Rose Kingdom had told me herself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Possessing overwhelming power to cut through
adversity.
A presence who brings hope to the people
all on his own.
That is the wise King Moss.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It is my origin, and my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—A wise monarch from a story she had read
so many times she could recite it by
heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“Once upon a time, there lived
a very brave dog named Moth.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'All on his own,
he vanquished the wicked great serpent that
ruled over a village.'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'He freed the people from the wicked serpent,
vowing to turn their land into a paradise
for all. And then—'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“In a single night, Moth carved out waterways,
tilled the fields, planted crops,
and enriched the village's barren land.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'When illness spread, he brewed medicine,
and in years of poor harvest,
he brought forth abundant food from parts
unknown.'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“The days Moth brought became a beacon of hope,
and filled with renewed vigor,
the villagers worked tirelessly.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“And before anyone realized it,
the land had become
a realm so bountiful it was hailed as a true
paradise.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I, too, wish to be like him.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to attain victory through overwhelming
might.
I wish to lead everyone with my own two
hands alone. And beyond that...
I wish to bring them hope.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I wish to make our Rose Kingdom
unshakeable,
and build a peace that shall endure for all
eternity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We can see this through.
No—we must see this through.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What we must accomplish next
in this racing world is—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is to accumulate victories across this
Twinkle Series,
and establish our 'Kingdom of the Rose' as
an unshakable realm.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...My Classic year taught me firsthand.
Only the truly formidable run in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If I wish to command a presence among them,
I must stack dazzling victory upon dazzling
victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ordinary effort will not suffice.
Overcoming such a towering wall
leaves us with many hurdles.
It will likely be our most grueling period
yet.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With steady resolve—
will you follow me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A smile slipped out despite myself.
I did not volunteer myself with the intention
of accompanying her
only along warm, gentle paths.
choice_data_list: Being by your side is my duty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the Asahi Hai FS to the Japan Cup,
the path was by no means smooth.
Yet, the reason I have walked this far is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of her powerful,
earnest steps.
If it is her,
she will undoubtedly accomplish
everything.
choice_data_list: I shall accompany you until the ve...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I believe that from the bottom of my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just by standing beside me,
you support me more than you could ever
know.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
We've spent quite a while talking.
Shall we get something to eat?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This time is set aside for you.
Please, enjoy it to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
For your amuse-bouche,
strawberry and beetroot tartlets.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Mm...
this refreshing tartness is rather
addictive.
Yet, what a striking red it is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Cauliflower potage...
This savory aroma—cacao nibs, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A delicate bitterness peeking out from
beneath the deep umami... Delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The main course is a classic roast beef
tenderloin—
with blackcurrant lending a tart sweetness
befitting Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I requested a Valentine's custom order,
and I must say...
They have exercised marvelous
craftsmanship.
choice_data_list: (This is way more lavish than I im...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward came the cheese course,
followed by the avant-dessert—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The dessert is fondant au chocolat.
If I may be so bold,
I took the liberty of selecting it
specially.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
These are from a patisserie trained in
Paris,
with whom our house has long maintained
close ties.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The black tea is an exquisite blend tailored
by my great-grandmother in France.
I do hope both... suit your palate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Internally overwhelmed by the consistently
elegant and extravagant Valentine's gift,
I bowed my head in gratitude.
choice_data_list: Thank you very much for the wonder...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
I spent the rest of that curiously
extraordinary
Valentine's night in her company.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The dessert is fondant au chocolat.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Truth be told,
I arrived at the shop a little early
today.
I consulted with the chef beforehand and,
presumptuous though it may be,
I lent a hand with making the ganache.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As you well know,
my culinary experience is virtually
nonexistent.
But I suppose that is the very essence of
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I heard from a classmate.
That it is a day to gift chocolate imbued
with feelings of gratitude, and—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I believe the true depth of one's
gratitude
is conveyed all the more when crafted with
one's own hands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore,
I wished for you to experience a greater
sense of satisfaction. Thus,
I opted for a full-course meal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the full-course meal came a fondant
au chocolat graced by her own personal
touch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most likely,
this was the result of her interpreting her
classmate's advice in her own unique way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Was something amiss?
Forgive me...
I am somewhat unaccustomed to commoner
customs.
choice_data_list: No, this is the most wonderful gif...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The ganache received the chef's personal
seal of approval.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please, enjoy it.
—I do hope it suits your palate.
